title: Rampant AI Demand for Memory Is Fueling a Growing Chip Crisis
title_zh: 人工智能对内存的旺盛需求正在加剧日益严重的芯片危机
summary: Since the start of 2026, Tesla Inc., Apple Inc. and a dozen other major corporations have signaled that the shortage of DRAM, or dynamic random access memory — the fundamental building block of almost all technology — will constrain production.
summary_zh: 自 2026 年初以来，特斯拉公司、苹果公司和其他十几家大公司已表示，动态随机存取存储器（几乎所有技术的基本组成部分）的短缺将限制生产。

title: Nvidia earnings are going to be a tell-tale sign for markets
title_zh: 英伟达的财报将成为市场的一个明显迹象
summary: RBC Wealth Management technical strategist Rob Sluymer explains how Nvidia (NVDA), as a leader among mega-cap tech stocks and AI trade player, will be a major indicator for the market (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) when it reports its fourth quarter earnings results on February 25.
summary_zh: 加拿大皇家银行财富管理技术策略师 Rob Sluymer 解释了英伟达 (NVDA) 作为大型科技股和人工智能交易领域的领导者，在 2 月 25 日公布第四季度盈利结果时将如何成为市场的主要指标（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）。

title: 'The dark side of AI': Wall Street weighs recent stock sell-off over disruption fears
title_zh: “人工智能的阴暗面”：华尔街因担心颠覆而权衡近期股票抛售
summary: Investor concerns over AI's disruption drove a stock market sell-off in the wealth management, transportation, and logistics industries.
summary_zh: 投资者对人工智能颠覆的担忧推动了财富管理、运输和物流行业的股市抛售。

title: Walmart earnings, spending data, and more AI disruptions: What to watch this week
title_zh: 沃尔玛盈利、支出数据和更多人工智能颠覆：本周值得关注的内容
summary: A holiday-shortened trading week and a continuing series of rolling AI sell-off greet investors in the week ahead.
summary_zh: 未来一周，投资者将迎来假期缩短的交易周和一系列持续的人工智能抛售。

title: As AI agents take over, security is becoming a bigger concern
title_zh: 随着人工智能代理的接管，安全性正成为一个更大的问题
summary: A new report from Microsoft says AI agents could pose a cybersecurity threat to some businesses.
summary_zh: 微软的一份新报告称，人工智能代理可能对某些企业构成网络安全威胁。
